caption: A photorealistic film still from a contemporary Chinese university romance short drama, cinematic live-action realism, square 1:1 image with 1024x1024 framing. Rich but natural skin texture, believable hands, fabrics and practical light, emotionally restrained acting, carefully staged subjects, no text, subtitles, logos or watermarks. Gu Xi is a 20-year-old Chinese female art student with long straight black hair, naturally expressive eyes, cream cardigan over white shirt and light blue jeans. Jiang Jin is a 22-year-old Chinese male computer science student with short neat black hair, charcoal jacket over white T-shirt, reserved face and a subtle old scar near his left wrist. Zhou Qian is a Chinese female student aged 21 with long wavy dark hair and powder blue outfit. H University digital art festival takes place in a real modern campus exhibition laboratory with a giant blue-violet LED display and realistic equipment. Nighttime wide establishing view inside the same digital arts exhibition hall. The huge LED exhibit is suddenly glitching, showing a fragmented luminous blue-violet game character and broken geometric pixels scattered over a circular respawn platform. Gu Xi is seen from behind, alone at the bottom center of frame, frozen before her malfunctioning installation. Dramatic contrast of dark surrounding room and cold distorted screen glow, suspenseful geometry, realistic physical display and cables.
